parameters.query:
WITH p AS (SELECT $1::uuid AS esc, $2::uuid AS lead, NULLIF(lower($3), '') AS area),
r AS (SELECT * FROM responsaveis
      WHERE id = escolher_responsavel((SELECT esc FROM p), (SELECT lead FROM p), (SELECT area FROM p), false, true))
SELECT to_jsonb(e) AS escritorio,
       to_jsonb(r) AS responsavel,
       COALESCE(r.google_calendar_id, e.google_calendar_id, '') AS calendar_id,
       COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(a.inicio, a.fim)) FROM agendamentos a
                 WHERE a.status IN ('marcado', 'confirmado') AND a.fim > now()
                   AND (a.responsavel_id = r.id OR (r.id IS NULL AND a.escritorio_id = e.id))), '[]') AS ocupados
FROM escritorios e LEFT JOIN r ON true
WHERE e.id = (SELECT esc FROM p);
